task: put the bowl on top of the cabinet

windows.text: Approach the grey bowl from above, lowering the open gripper down toward it.
Approach the grey bowl from above, lowering the open gripper toward its rim.
Approach the grey bowl from above, lowering the open gripper around its rim.
Grasp the grey bowl on the table and lift it upward.
Lift the bowl up off the table, raising it above the pink plate.
Lift the bowl up off the table, lifting it above the black bottle.
Carry the bowl horizontally toward the dark cabinet, moving it over the bottle.
Lower the bowl down onto the top surface of the black cabinet.
Release the bowl onto the top of the cabinet and open the gripper.
